messages:
Emma: Quick sync — launching a short mini-burst to drive webinar signups next Tue. Goal = 1.2k registrants, CPL target $18, landing page variant B. Need: search & retarget setup, creative handoff, and inbound routing to SDR queue. :rocket:
Raj: On it. For search, we should cap bids by hour-of-day + geo. I'll start with a conservative max CPC and let auto-bid ramp.
Luis: Creative note — we only have 2 hero images that scale. Can we do 3 headline variants and 2 descriptions? I can spin the variants tonight.
Emma: Yes — 3 headlines, 2 desc, 2 CTAs. Also add one messaging variant that leans product reliability for enterprise vs one for developer-first.
Maya: For retargeting, I recommend a 7-day site visitor window with a 3x frequency cap. We'll run a separate ad set for previous webinar registrants (exclude) and for trial users (higher bid).
Ben: Routing: when someone registers, send to HubSpot form -> if company size >50 or domain matches target list then route to SDR queue A else Marketing nurtures. Nora, can you confirm HubSpot filters?
Nora: Confirmed. HubSpot filter: company_size, domain_whitelist, utm_source. I'll add a boolean field `sdr_qualify` and an automation to push qualified leads to Slack channel #sdr-leads.
Emma: Awesome. Also please ensure UTM tagging so we can attribute. Use this pattern: `utm_source=paid_search&utm_medium=cpc&utm_campaign=q3_webinar_mini_burst&utm_content={creative}`
AdOpsBot: Daily budget cap check scheduled. Notifying if spend projection > 110% of daily cap.
Raj: Drafted search ad groups and negative keyword list. Pushing to Google Ads account now. Quick snippet:
```
Ad Group: Webinar - Dev
Keywords: "llm inference api", "low latency llm api", "gpu inference platform"
Max CPC: $4.50
Negative: "open source model download", "research paper"
```
Luis: Creative variants (WIP):
1) Headline A: "Predictable LLM inference, less ops"
2) Headline B: "Ship LLM features with consistent latency"
3) Headline C: "Lower token costs, faster responses"
Desc1: "Hosted, Dedicated, Private — pick what fits your compliance needs."
Desc2: "SLA-backed endpoints & cost controls for production teams."
CTA options: "Register Now" / "Save Your Seat"
Maya: Retarget copy for trial users: "Upgrading inference should be easy — join our webinar to see how teams cut costs 2x"
Ben: For pacing: start with 60% budget first 24h, then 80% next 48h if CPA <= $18, else scale back to 40%. Set automated rules to pause low-performing creatives after 6h if CTR < 0.35%.
Emma: Love it. Can everyone update the shared Google doc by EOD and tag me? I'll do a final creative QA tomorrow morning. :eyes: 
Luis: Will add creative assets + naming convention to the doc. Using prefix `Q3-miniburst_webinar_`
Nora: HubSpot form ready. I'll test the webhook and post a sample to #marketing-checks when done.
Raj: Live with initial search set. Monitoring now.
Emma: Thanks team — let's aim for a quick retrospective Fri to capture learnings and any pivot on messaging. :thumbsup:
